reason: No existing skill covers a module that polls or syncs an external service on a timer, starts a detached watcher from web start, and closes a ticket from the external issue. Paperclip, twilio and cloud share this pattern, so the class-level skill is created here, with the Paperclip F3 work as its first case.

The episode fixed a watcher that only started from one folder's web start and never ended. The lessons (every entry point starts it, self-ending idle exit, env not inherited by the child, test Popen stub) are the watcher class's rules and belong in this skill, which already governs timer-synced modules.
